title: Metering/budget record ownership map (one writer per field)
description: The machine-readable producer seam for the frozen metering/budget record shape (issue #425). For every canonical field of metering-record.schema.json this map names exactly ONE side that emits it — so 'the record shape exists but nothing produces it' (kushin77/deepseek#115) cannot recur silently. A field with no producer is unowned and is refused by name; a field with two producers is a second authority and is refused by name. scripts/check-metering-parity.sh reads this map with the schema and field-map.json and refuses either case.

fleet-metering.emits: the identity, measured-quantity and call-attribution fields of every absorbed model-call record

fleet-run-identity.emits: the run/session id stamped on every record the session produces

fleet-budget.emits: the budget scope, period, cap, spend, hard-stop and burn-rate attribution, and the cap/saving claims

fleet-paperclip-adapter.emits: the per-task receipt that ties spend to a ticket, and its evidence reference

peer-deepseek-export.emits: the peer export's own records, mapped onto this same shape

peer-ollama-budget.emits: the second peer producer's budget records, mapped onto this same shape

peer.third_producer: kushin77/ollama#199 (token-budget enforcement at the context window)
peer.role: producer of their own records, mapped onto this shape — never an editor of this contract (NG4)

identity.tenantId.meaning: the tenant the spend is attributed to

identity.agentId.meaning: the agent whose call this is

identity.runId.meaning: the run/session that emitted the call

identity.sourceType.meaning: which sibling record shape the row was absorbed from

identity.sourceKey.meaning: the source record's key within its own shape

quantity.costUsd.meaning: the resolved cost, or null when unmetered

quantity.costSource.meaning: why the cost figure is trustworthy

receipt.ticket.meaning: the ticket the spend is tied to

receipt.evidence.meaning: the evidence reference backing the receipt

attribution.taskClass.meaning: the task class the chooser attributed

attribution.scope.level.meaning: the scoping level of the cap

attribution.scope.id.meaning: the agent/team/project id the cap applies to

attribution.cap.meaning: the spend limit for the period

claims.meaning: the asserted cap/saving claims, each with its evidence
